correctness.rationale: The projection kernel is the Walsh transform of the residue-class frequency indicator, with its normalized L1 norm exactly the minimal projection norm by translation averaging. The cube-root filter gives all kernel values at Hamming weights 0..n, and even/odd binomial sums A_n,B_n yield the two-level formulas and strictly positive gap for n>=3. Independent integer FWHT checked n=3..9 and all three residues; roots-of-unity algebra proves unbounded n.
